title: Setting
description: One setting the launcher keeps, as semiont settings shows it.

name.description: Its name, as semiont settings takes it.

default.description: Whether this is the machine-wide form of a knowledge-base setting (secret-store --default).

appliesTo.description: What it applies to: every knowledge base on this machine, or one.

values.description: The values in effect, one per line semiont settings shows.

settable.description: Whether settings.set and settings.unset change it.

changedBy.description: For one they do not: how it is changed instead.
